description: Progress of a task or usage of a quota, with tone and loading state.

howToUse: Use it to show how much of a task is done: upload, import, steps of a sign-up.
Pass `value` from 0 to 100, and write the number or the step next to it ("3 of 5").
Use `indeterminate` when the end is unknown. Use `tone="warning"` or `"danger"` when the value means trouble.
alternatives: Usage of a plan against its limit: UsageMeter.
A short wait inside a button or small area: Spinner.

keyboard.action: The bar does not receive focus. Screen readers read the value.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Fill color. `neutral` (ink) is the tone of the quota bars
in settings screens: informative, without judging state.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description:
Loading without known progress: the fill slides in a loop.
Exposes `aria-busy` and omits `aria-valuenow`. With `prefers-reduced-motion`
the animation stops (track filled at half opacity).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

examples.description: Neutral tone (ink): informative quota bar for settings screens, a ratio without judging state (e.g. "5 / 20 active projects").

examples.label: Animated value
examples.description: The fill width is animated (motion token): click the buttons and watch the bar "grow"/"shrink" to the new value instead of jumping.

examples.label: Loading
examples.description: `indeterminate`: continuous loading without a known percentage; the fill slides in a loop. Accessibility: `aria-busy`, no `aria-valuenow`. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, the animation stops and the track is filled at half opacity.
